filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint.
Currently supported filters are:

+ grantable: filters roles based on whether they are selectable for a membership

+ unit: filters roles based on the unit ('project' or 'system') for which they are selectable for a membership (operations: list)

id.description: Role id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: get)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
